# vllm.txt 와 같은 파드를 20초 뒤에 한 번 더 읽은 값 — 그 사이 요청 20개(TTFT)·토큰 40개(ITL)가 더 쌓였다 (DURO-124).
# 차이(delta)로 낸 p95 는 TTFT 975ms(0.75~1.0s 버킷 사이), ITL 50ms(+Inf 버킷에 걸려 가장 큰 유한 상한).
# 누적 그대로 내면 TTFT 892.9ms 라 둘이 다르다 — 테스트가 "최근 구간" 인지 가린다.
# HELP vllm:num_requests_running Number of requests in model execution batches.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_running gauge
vllm:num_requests_running{engine="0",model_name="openai/gpt-oss-20b"} 8.0
# HELP vllm:num_requests_waiting Number of requests waiting to be processed.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_waiting gauge
vllm:num_requests_waiting{engine="0",model_name="openai/gpt-oss-20b"} 0.0
# HELP vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc KV-cache usage. 1 means 100 percent usage.
# TYPE vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc gauge
vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{engine="0",model_name="openai/gpt-oss-20b"} 0.021
# HELP vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds Histogram of time to first token in seconds.

vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{engine="0",le="0.75",model_name="openai/gpt-oss-20b"} 106.0
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{engine="0",le="1.0",model_name="openai/gpt-oss-20b"} 120.0
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{engine="0",le="+Inf",model_name="openai/gpt-oss-20b"} 120.0
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{engine="0",model_name="openai/gpt-oss-20b"} 120.0
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum{engine="0",model_name="openai/gpt-oss-20b"} 48.9
